name: Edge FX
description: Edge lighting preview and control (AMOLED display effect), Edge panel toggle and install/uninstall state for the Nuxel Edge FX app

storage: none (Edge Lighting settings live in /etc/nuxel/edge-lighting/edge-lighting.json through the bridge provider)
facilities: edge-lighting RPC (status/set/preview/reset) via the shared bridge client
canonical app registry install/uninstall (apps RPC) — this app can remove or reinstall itself
